# Typst

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/typst.md`.

- TYPST-01 prefer: Format with `typstyle --wrap-text=sentence --line-width 160` locally and in CI; build through a script that downloads fonts into a git-ignored `fonts/`. [tool:typstyle]
- TYPST-02 lean: Write CV bullets one achievement per bullet, verb first, with concrete scope (customers, team size, technology), semicolon-chained clauses, no first person and no self-praise.
- TYPST-03 lean: Write dates as `MM/YYYY - MM/YYYY`, the title line as `Role · Role · Role`, and contact items separated by `|`; extract repeated markup into named helpers (`contact-item`, `contact-sep`).
